# Third-party notices

These classroom skills were informed by a review of selected skills in [nexscope-ai/Amazon-Skills](https://github.com/nexscope-ai/Amazon-Skills), licensed under the MIT License. The BrewGo instructions were rewritten for small offline classroom datasets and do not include Nexscope's network collection, promotional, or time-sensitive platform guidance.

Reviewed upstream skills: `amazon-review-analyzer`, `amazon-return-reduction`, `amazon-inventory-management`, `amazon-international-listings`, and `amazon-a-plus-content`.
